CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory
Accreditation: CPA UK Ltd, ISO 15189:2012

Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
Hospital No: [redacted ID]
Specimen: Peripheral blood
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL DETAILS
Infant referred for cytogenetic analysis

TEST REQUESTED
G-banded chromosome analysis

RESULT
Culture failed - No material suitable for cytogenetic analysis

The blood sample was set up in culture for G-banded chromosome analysis. Unfortunately, the culture failed to yield metaphases suitable for analysis. No cytogenetic result can be provided from this sample.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Separate PCR analysis was performed which showed normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. This preliminary screening does not replace full karyotype analysis.

RECOMMENDATION
A repeat blood sample in lithium heparin (2-3ml) is required if G-banded chromosome analysis is still clinically indicated. Please ensure sample reaches the laboratory within 24 hours of collection.

Reported by: [redacted name]
Consultant Clinical Scientist
Authorised by: [redacted name]
Laboratory Director
